scope: Existing independent portal acceptance environment. Public website, Vercel configuration, DNS and all provider credentials unchanged.
implemented: Operations ownership follow-up for registered-holder changes, registrar-account custody moves and external transfers
Creation verifies dedicated-account registration/custody read-only before saving a minimal baseline
Admin-only persisted tasks, versioned progress, immutable event history and atomic audit
Idempotent create/progress requests, duplicate active-task prevention and stale-update rejection
Consent evidence gate before registrar follow-up
No manually selectable verified/completed status and no registrar execution endpoint
Concise client-creation wording without changing provisioning or credential behavior

legalBehavior.registeredHolder: Save an official contact and PUT /domains/{domain}/contacts after separate approval, preserving other contact IDs. Complete provider notices and verify the resulting registrant contact and verification status. Registrar acceptance alone is not completion.
legalBehavior.custody: Documented registrar dashboard: Domain List, select domain, Transfer, Transfer ownership. Confirm receiving account and contact handling. Follow actual provider prompts and independently verify custody in the receiving account.
legalBehavior.externalTransfer: Separate transfer-out procedure. Review eligibility, explicit unlock/code authorization and receiving-registrar confirmation. Keep authorization codes outside task notes.
legalBehavior.completion: Tasks track follow-up only. No legal ownership result is certified by these tables, statuses or ordinary portal assignments.
legalBehavior.communications: Required registrar confirmation emails are provider-controlled and are not claimed to be StackEndBox-branded or suppressible. Normal portal notifications retain the separate client Brevo integration.

realCustomer.founderAction: Open Admin Domains, choose new/existing client, enter the approved identity and onboarding method securely, enter the domain, Verify and review, confirm the exact pairing and Activate Client Access with fresh MFA. Legal change is a separate approved operation.

publication.smallestTechnicalChange: Existing prepared two-path Vercel rewrite configuration with portal-only upstream and private caching rules
publication.commercialPolicy: Current Hobby terms permit non-commercial personal use only. Business portal proxying does not resolve eligibility. No compliant activation is claimed under the unchanged free/frozen-routing constraints.
publication.rollback: Existing prepared routing-only rollback removes the two rewrites/restores the recorded public deployment without deleting client data or changing DNS.
